subtitles.en: Paul's polemic against requiring Gentile circumcision

descriptions.en: A fiery letter to the Galatian churches, written against missionaries who pressed Gentile converts to be circumcised and observe the Mosaic law. Paul argues that Gentiles are justified by faith in Christ alone, apart from works of law.
